description: Reads the developer's part of Neblla's store (Mundo): the 3D things they sell, each sale charged on the author's own Stripe payout account. "mine" → your products (with their check and sales); "get" { id }; "check" { kind, look?, file | fileUrl } → the report of the check every file passes before it is published (weight, triangles and textures; a thing for the doll is tried on 5 extreme bodies), without creating a product; "fee" { license, price } → Neblla's commission; "assets" → what you bought with a developer's licence; "sanctions" → your record in the store: Neblla's steps on reported products (warning, removal, ban). Until Neblla opens the store it sells in Stripe's test mode (test: true). Changes nothing; neblla_store creates, publishes, withdraws and reports.
name: neblla_store_read
title: Store (read)
